---
title: Scholar metadata for an explicitly included reference
format: html
google-scholar: true
bibliography: references.bib
nocite: '@included'
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElementCount:
        - selectors: ['meta[name="citation_reference"]', '.csl-entry[id^="ref-"]']
          counts: [2, 2]
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_author=Alice Smith;"]', 'meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_author=Bob Jones;"]']
        - ['meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_author=Carol Brown;"]']
---

This article cites one work [@cited] and includes another in its bibliography.
